title: Foodweb guild migration attributes (16-guild model)
description: Per-guild migration parameters for the 16-guild MIMES foodweb model: initial biomass ranges (min/max/adjust, in tons), horizontal migration strength (0-1), food biomass thresholds, low/high M:F ratios. Drives migration dynamics between adjacent polygons in the marine sub-model.
